items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I lost interest a little bit in the piano when I heard the orchestra director, Maclo Williams, play the violin, as a young kid... I wanted to play the violin like Mr. Williams did

ctx.x: Well, when did you decide you thought you could kind of make it pretty good on the piano?

Oh, I don't know -- I lost interest a little bit in the piano when I heard the orchestra director, Maclo Williams, play the violin, as a young kid, you know -- I must have been about 10 or 11 then, and I suppose nothing would satisfy me but -- I asked my mother to get me a violin; I wanted to play the violin like Mr. Williams did, you see.
